name: Old Timber (Rye Cocktail With Fernet)

ingredients.name: Jelínek Czech-style fernet, Fernet Leopold, or Fernet Francisco
triple sec, such as Combier or Cointreau

instructions.primary_message: Add rye, fernet, and triple sec to a mixing glass and fill with ice. Stir until well chilled, about 30 seconds. Add a large ice cube to a rocks glass and strain cocktail into glass. Garnish with cinnamon stick, express orange oils onto drink, and add twist to glass.

schema_metadata.keywords: amaro, cocktail, fall, fernet, rye, whiskey

description: If you like Old Fashioneds, you'll enjoy this simple stirred cocktail, created by Gabe Cothes of San Francisco's Salt House. It's deeply woodsy, with added depth and aroma from fernet, an Italian amaro, and orangey triple sec.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Cinnamon stick and orange twist, for garnish

Notes: Be careful with your fernet: This drink comes out medicinal and menthol-heavy when made with the popular Fernet-Branca. Instead, use cinnamon-y Jelínek Czech-style fernet, minty Fernet Leopold, or super-dry Fernet Francisco.
author: Maggie Hoffman
